title: Oceans To Hold More Plastic Than Fish by 2050
main_content:
There will be more plastic than fish in the world’s oceans by 2050, unless more recycling takes place.

If the current trend continues, oceans will contain one ton of plastic for every three tons of fish in 2025.

By 2050, plastics will weigh more than fish.

The problem is that each year at least 8 million tons of plastics end up in oceans around the world.

Not all plastic ends up in the ocean just because someone throws a plastic bottle into the water.

Plastic containers and other trash thrown onto streets and sidewalks often are swept into oceans.

There is a way to slow the amount of plastics going into the oceans – people can recycle more.

The report’s authors say that currently only about 14 percent of plastics are recycled.

For decades, scientists have warned that plastics are killing fish.
